nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Violet Ice Cold Plunge Pore Minimizing Mask with Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or T-zone oiliness report visibly smaller pores and reduced shine after use, and several recommend the mask specifically for oily skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin describes the mask as very hydrating rather than drying, though most other reviews position it as a clarifying, oil-drawing clay mask.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother, less oily T-zones and smaller-looking pores without their skin feeling stripped.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: most report no irritation despite the cooling, tingling sensation, but one reviewer describes burning and redness severe enough to remove the mask immediately.

concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report the mask helped bring breakouts to the surface, reduce clogged pores, or calm active pimples without triggering new ones; one reviewer with very sensitive skin credits the salicylic acid with slowly diminishing her clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: The mask's most reported effect is reduced shine and smaller-looking pores, especially around the T-zone, with several reviewers using it as a weekly reset for oily or combination skin.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the mask helped reduce red tones alongside clearing acne; this benefit is not corroborated elsewhere in the reviews.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the mask does not leave skin feeling dry or stripped, but a few report mild dryness afterward or the need to follow with moisturizer, while one reviewer specifically recommends it for dry skin.

aspects.libelle: Stinging or burning on very sensitive skin
Creamy texture that spreads and rinses easily
Vivid violet color seen as fun
Small bottle for the recommended 2-3x-weekly use
Mild chemical or dye-like scent for some users

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive skin so, the icy feeling on this mask concerned me. I didn't like the way it felt and was counting down the seconds to take it off. However, my skin felt clean and refreshed afterwards and it didn't cause any irritation. So, if you don't mind an icy hot sort of feel on your face, this may be the mask for you! This product was gifted to me in exchange for an honest review.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Refreshing face mask and helps reduce oily spots surrounding my T-zone and nose. I definitely felt the cooling effect as it would dry and could see noticeable spots of the mask soaking up oil from my skin. While not a dramatic difference, I did feel that the appearance of my pores looked cleaner. Definitely recommend if you struggle with oily spots!

I got this on a discount, I struggle with acne and clogged pores. I figured might as well try it out since it has good reviews. I saw some poor reviews on this product that fully contradict mine. I have VERY sensitive skin, and eczema and this product doesnt burn it honestly just feels somewhat cold which feels nice. Im very sensitive to smells, and it just smells like good soap, doesnt smell too strong or chemically. Like the nice soap they use when you get your hair done yk? And its all over my nose and under my nose so I can definitely smell it. But ill update if it helps my nasty pores haha
So so hydrating! Definitely a need when your skin it dry. It's so smooth and makes your skin feel soft. Easy to use packaging and it smells good. Even bought one for my mom to try.

I have very sensitive skin specifically when it comes to salicylic acid and i was hesitant on this product but i can say that after trying this my clogged pores really have been diminishing slowly but surely!

extraits.titre: Perfect for sensitive and oily skin!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Violet Ice Cold Plunge Pore Mask and I'm honestly really impressed. Right after using it, my skin felt so much cleaner and refreshed, plus the cooling sensation is amazing. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and tend to get oily, but this mask really helped calm my breakouts and control the oil without irritating my skin. It smells nice (kind of floral), and the texture is smooth and easy to apply. I also noticed that my pores looked smaller with consistent use. This has definitely become a new favorite in my skincare routine.
